Appearances:
 Mr. Gurpreet Singh, Advocate for petitioners.
 Mr. Aashneet Singh, App. Si Rishi Kant Mishra, Ps-Sj Enclave.
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Prateek Jalan
 Order

By way of these petitions under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 173/2025 dated 22.04.2025 registered at Police Station Safdarjung Enclave, District South West, Delhi, under Sections 420/406/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
The matter was mentioned for out-of-turn hearing on the submission of learned counsel for the parties that all parties are present before this Court.
However, during the course of the hearing, it is observed that one of the parties has joined the proceedings through video conferencing from an airport, while some parties are not present at all.
This is a digitally signed order.
